format_notes.folds: list of {id, train, heldout, n_train, n_heldout, train_md5, heldout_md5}
format_notes.order_rule: every stem list is in pool order: the legacy train.txt order, then the legacy val.txt order (the B6 rule, b6_make_roots.py); a root's splits/train.txt = 'train', splits/val.txt = splits/test.txt = 'heldout'
format_notes.list_md5_rule: md5 of the UTF-8 bytes of '\n'.join(stems) + '\n' (= md5sum of the split file a root writes, one stem per line)
format_notes.roots: bench_make_roots writes <ROOTS>/<name>_<id>/splits/train.txt = train, val.txt = test.txt = heldout; labeled symlink as for B6
format_notes.forbidden: stems that must never appear in any train / heldout list of a development root, and that the scorer refuses outside a registered opening

author: cv5v3 builder (stage C)

name: cv5v3
description: module-grouped 5-fold CV over the 532 legacy train + val cells; = cv5v2 with every group of the corrected grouping (cv5v2 groups + physical-module identity v3 rule B + the 4 open image-id pairs + cells.tsv module links) in one fold; 47 cells moved (results/stageC/CV5V3_BUILD.md)

pool.gaint_reference: B6 DATA_MANIFEST.md5 2630f630 covers the same 532 stems (file-level md5s on gaint; not re-checked here)

groups.rule: connected components of pool cells over: the cv5v2 groups (never split), the image id, the rule-B physical module (module_identity_v3.tsv), the four open image-id pairs of score_exclude_v2c.txt taken as linked, and the cells.tsv module_group (earlier links kept also without pixel support); name = smallest cv5v2 group name inside
groups.fold_rule: a group inside one cv5v2 fold keeps it; a group spanning cv5v2 folds goes to the fold holding most of its cells; ties: smallest balance cost (sum of squared deviations of crack-cell and inactive-cell counts per fold), then the lowest fold; tied groups placed after all others, in ascending group name (results/stageC/CV5V3_BUILD.md s1)
amendments: L6 added: SDLE pool cells whose stem names the same module (SDLE_<n>_<module>-...) are one group
R3 amended: equal balance cost -> the tied fold with fewer cells after the placement, then the lowest fold
